global.intensity: slight: max rotation of moving part ~amplitude deg (0 = path/glow only); art opacity 0.25-0.4 at rest
global.trigger: plays on select (once, then loops every period with a 2-4 s idle hold so it is subtle); idle loop only when zoom shows constellation >25% of screen
global.loop: every animation returns exactly to rest pose at t=period (seamless)
global.rig: moving part = art region pivoted at named anchor; implement as mesh-warp/bone on the anchor-warped art quad, lines follow attached stars visually only (star positions never move)
global.reduced_motion: if prefers-reduced-motion or app setting: no movement, no particles; show static art + single 400 ms opacity fade; target arrow/stream shown as static dotted line
global.battery: pause when app hidden; cap 30 fps for anim layer

line_trace_in.order: from brightest star outward along lines_hr

star_pulse.members: brighten 1.3x, one 600 ms pulse as trace reaches each

label.name: IAU name + English, large, centered on art centroid, fade 500 ms after trace

phases.do: draw bow: bow arm pulls back ~4 deg, string bends
arrow sprite flies along great circle from arrow tip (Kaus Australis area) to Antares (HR 6134); thin fading trail
Antares flashes 1.5x for 300 ms; arrow fades
bow arm relaxes, new arrow fades in (reload)
